map.伯明翰血管炎活动评分（BVAS v3），9个器官系统加权评分，评估系统性血管炎活: Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score (BVAS v3), 9 organ-system weighted scoring, assesses systemic vasculitis activity
map.勾选近4周内新发或加重的血管炎相关临床表现，系统按权重自动计算BVAS总分: Check vasculitis-related clinical manifestations newly appearing or worsening within the past 4 weeks; the system auto-calculates the BVAS total by weight
map.分组勾选：全身3+皮肤3+肾6+肺4+神经2 = 18（各系统按 max 封顶）: Group check: systemic 3 + skin 3 + renal 6 + lung 4 + neuro 2 = 18 (each system capped at max); ≥15 severe, induction remission therapy.
map.合计 6（皮肤3+关节3）→ 轻中活动，门诊随访。: Total 6 (skin 3 + joint 3) → mild-moderate activity, outpatient follow-up.
map.本页为评分式（rater），bvas 为展示式，均用 BVAS v3 分组封顶规: This page is the rating form (rater), bvas is the display form; both use BVAS v3 group-capping rules.
map.每系统最高按 max 计（如肾最高 6），避免单系统过度拉高总分、更反映多系统受: Each system is capped at its max (e.g. renal max 6), preventing one system from over-inflating the total and better reflecting multi-system involvement.
map.本工具基于伯明翰血管炎活动评分第3版（BVAS v3），纯前端运行，数据不会上传: This tool is based on the Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score version 3 (BVAS v3), runs entirely in-browser, data is not uploaded to any server
map.BVAS含9个器官系统（全身、皮肤、黏膜眼、耳鼻喉、胸部、心血管、腹部、肾脏、神: BVAS has 9 organ systems (systemic, skin, mucosal-eye, ENT, chest, cardiovascular, abdominal, renal, neurologic), max total about 63
map.每系统有最高分上限，超过上限按上限计分: Each system has a maximum cap; exceeding it is scored at the cap
map.BVAS用于AAV（ANCA相关性血管炎）等系统性血管炎活动度评估，指导治疗决策: BVAS is used to assess activity of systemic vasculitis such as AAV (ANCA-associated vasculitis), guiding treatment decisions
map.伯明翰血管炎活动评分第3版（BVAS v3），评估9个器官系统（全身、皮肤、黏膜: Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score version 3 (BVAS v3) assesses vasculitis activity across 9 organ systems (systemic, skin, mucosal-eye, ENT, chest, cardiovascular, abdominal, renal, neurologic), each weighted with a cap, max total 63.
map.各系统最高分上限自动控制: Automatic control of each system's maximum cap
map.受累系统分布与分层治疗建议: Involved system distribution and stratified treatment suggestions
map.血管炎治疗疗效与复发监测: Vasculitis treatment efficacy and relapse monitoring
